issues.summary: REG48_Part_Information: register reset 0h contradicts field resets 3h and 1h
issues.description:
Section 7.5.1.57, REG48_Part_Information Register (Offset = 48h), page 128. The heading gives [reset = 0h], and Figure 7-82 shows R-0h for every field. Table 7-70 lists the reset of PN_2:0 (bits 5-3) as 3h and DEV_REV_2:0 (bits 2-0) as 1h, which compose to 19h, not 0h.
Please state which value the device returns after reset. If the part number and device revision are fixed, the heading and Figure 7-82 should read 19h, R-3h, and R-1h to match Table 7-70.

issues.summary: REG2E_ADC_Control ADC_AVG: value 1h description ends mid-phrase
issues.description: Table 7-55, REG2E_ADC_Control Register Field Descriptions, page 113, bit 3 ADC_AVG. The description of value 1h reads "Running average (not available for)" and ends without saying what running average is not available for. A transcription of the HTML version of this datasheet reads "Running average (not available for IBAT discharge)", so the term appears to be missing from the PDF only.
